These points target ratio thresholds and separately informative V1 and V2 tails in regions where measured errors are large. Donor, acid, charged P/O, sulfoxide, nitrogen, and oxygen-rich carbonyl rows repair recurrent chemical failure modes, while m24, m32, and m73 provide neutral calibration controls that limit correction leakage into ordinary rows. The mixture covers low, intermediate, and strong eluent, includes loading contrasts where they can test conditional effects, and spans compact through very broad predicted intervals.
